ar: اليوم سنتحدث عن سؤال الوحدة: هل يمكن للطلاب التعلم بطرق مختلفة؟
en: Today we are going to talk about the Unit Question: Can students learn in different ways?
questions: Is the question about learning methods?

ar: أنا لا أحب الجلوس طوال اليوم. أريد أن أتحرك.
en: I don’t like sitting all day. I want to be able to move around.
questions: Does Marcus like sitting all day?
What does he want to do?

ar: أعتقد أنه من المهم الجلوس والانتباه في الصف.
en: I think it is important to sit down and pay attention in class.
questions: Does Yuna agree with moving around?
What does she think is important?

ar: أعرف مدرسة يكون فيها الطلاب في الخارج طوال اليوم.
en: I know about a school where students are outside all day.
questions: Where are students in Felix’s example school?
Does Felix think active learning is good?

ar: ربما يمكن للطلاب التعلم بطرق مختلفة في مدارس مختلفة.
en: Maybe students can learn in different ways in different schools.
questions: What does Felix think about learning styles?

ar: في بلدي، الطلاب يقضون وقتاً طويلاً وهم يجلسون.
en: In my country, students spend a lot of time sitting down.
questions: Do students sit a lot in Sophy’s country?
What does she think about new learning methods?

ar: ربما طريقة جديدة للتعلم ستكون مفيدة.
en: Maybe a new way of learning would be helpful.
questions: Does Sophy support new learning methods?

ar: في دول مختلفة، يوجد أنواع مختلفة من المدارس.
en: In different countries, students go to many different kinds of schools.
questions: Are schools the same in all countries?
